workflows.name: Base stat radar / parametric geometry driver
workflows.user_goal: Look up a Pokemon by name or ID and pull its six base stats (HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed), height/weight/types, and both sprite image URLs (front_default, official artwork), to drive parametric geometry (radar/spider diagrams, stat-sized swarms of shapes) and image samplers natively in Grasshopper
workflows.data_shape: single pokemon -> item fields (height, weight, sprite URLs) + parallel stat name/value lists

workflows.name: Batch Pokedex table (tabular benchmark, read direction)
workflows.user_goal: Given a list/tree of Pokemon names or IDs on the canvas, fetch each in one batch and output a parallel tree of key fields (types, height, weight, base experience, stat totals) -- the read-side equivalent of the cross-platform tabular benchmark: turning a simple list into a full data table, except the table is sourced FROM the API rather than written TO it (PokeAPI has no write endpoints)
workflows.data_shape: list of names/ids -> tree of records, one branch per input, parallel-indexed
workflows.benchmark: tabular-to-platform (adapted: API is read-only, so this is table-from-platform, not table-to-platform)

workflows.name: Type effectiveness matrix
workflows.user_goal: Build the full 18x18 type damage-relations matrix (double/half/no damage to/from) from the type resource, as a tabular tree suitable for a heatmap grid or lookup table on the canvas -- something tedious to assemble by hand from 18 separate API pages, trivial as one tree-flattening component in GH
workflows.data_shape: all types -> 18x18 tree, row = attacking type, column = defending type, value = multiplier
workflows.benchmark: tabular-to-platform (adapted: full matrix built from repeated reads)

workflows.name: Evolution chain graph
workflows.user_goal: Fetch a species' evolution chain and flatten it into parent->child edges with trigger conditions (level, item, trade, etc.), so Grasshopper can generate a parametric branching diagram (node positions computed from tree depth) instead of the user tracing the chain by hand
workflows.data_shape: evolution-chain id -> flattened tree of {parent, child, trigger} edges, branch per chain depth

workflows.name: Move / ability lookup for team-building tools
workflows.user_goal: Look up a move or ability's mechanical fields (power, accuracy, PP, damage class, effect text) by name, for use as inputs into a larger parametric team-planning or damage-calculation graph built on the GH canvas
workflows.data_shape: single move or ability -> item of scalar fields

workflows.name: v2.0.0: audio cries
workflows.user_goal: Hear a Pokemon's cry alongside its other data on the canvas, without a separate manual download/playback step
workflows.data_shape: single pokemon -> two cry URLs (item) + in-memory audio bytes on trigger

workflows.name: v2.0.0: type matchups
workflows.user_goal: Given an attacking type, quickly see which types it's super-effective, resisted, or immune against, without reading the full to/from matrix from Get Type

workflows.name: v2.0.0: parametric stat radar visuals
workflows.user_goal: Turn a Pokemon's base stat values into a normalized 2D radar/spider chart polygon, colored by its canonical type color, for parametric stat-comparison geometry directly on the canvas

workflows.name: v2.1.0: dual-type defense
workflows.user_goal: Given a two-type Pokemon (e.g. fire/flying), see its true combined defensive multiplier against every attacking type (4x/2x/1x/0.5x/0.25x/0x), not just one type's own relations
workflows.data_shape: 2 types -> 6 bucketed lists of attacking type names

workflows.name: v2.1.0: generation-scoped species rosters
workflows.user_goal: Pull every species ID/name introduced in a given generation (1-9) plus its main region, to drive generation-scoped tools without hand-listing species
workflows.data_shape: 1 generation number -> list of species IDs + list of species names + 1 region

workflows.name: v2.1.0: item and nature lookup for team/breeding tools
workflows.user_goal: Pull an item's category/cost/fling power/effect/sprite, or a nature's stat modifiers and berry-flavor preferences, for team-building and EV-planning tools alongside the existing move/ability lookup
workflows.data_shape: single item or nature -> item of scalar fields

workflows.name: v2.1.0: real-world scale reference geometry
workflows.user_goal: Convert PokeAPI's raw decimetre/hectogram height/weight fields into metric+imperial units and a placeable reference Box, so a Pokemon's real-world scale can drive parametric geometry directly

workflows.name: v2.1.0: 3D stat mesh and viewport display helpers
workflows.user_goal: Extrude base stats into a solid 3D radar mesh (a stronger visual comparison than the flat polyline), get dual-type color swatches, filter a Pokedex-scale list down to matches, and lay out a sprite + stats as a viewport 'trading card'
workflows.data_shape: stat values -> Mesh; 2 types -> 3 colors; parallel name/value lists -> filtered subset; name+stats+bitmap+point -> card Mesh+label+plane
